title: RESERVOIR,VIC-3073 - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An earlier power outage affected network equipment in Reservoir, VIC 3073, causing a loss of service for some customers. Power has been restored and services are back online. We are monitoring the area. If your connection has not returned, please restart your modem/router and connection box (if you have one).

updates.content: Services in Reservoir (VIC 3073) were interrupted due to a local power outage affecting network equipment in the area. Power has been restored and services are back online. If your connection has not come back, please restart your modem/router and connection box (if you have one). We are monitoring for stability. Thank you for your patience.
